questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A particle performs simple harmonic motion with amplitude 10 cm and time period 4 seconds. What is the maximum velocity of the particle?
questions.explanation: Maximum velocity v_max = Aω = A(2π/T) = 10 × (2π/4) = 5π cm/s.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A convex lens of focal length 20 cm forms an image that is twice the size of the object. What are the possible object distances?
questions.explanation: Using magnification m = ±2 and lens formula 1/f = 1/v - 1/u. For m = 2: u = 10 cm (virtual). For m = -2: u = 30 cm (real). Answer: 10 cm or 30 cm.
questions.imagePrompt: Clean physics diagram on white background. Shows convex lens (focal length 20 cm) with optical axis horizontal. Object (upward arrow) placed on left side. Two ray diagrams: Top - object at 10 cm showing virtual, erect, magnified image (m=+2) on same side. Bottom - object at 30 cm showing real, inverted, magnified image (m=-2) on right side. Focal points F and 2F marked clearly. All distances labeled in cm. Professional optics textbook style.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Two resistors of 4Ω and 6Ω are connected in parallel across a 12V battery. What is the total current drawn from the battery?
questions.explanation: Equivalent resistance R_eq = (4×6)/(4+6) = 2.4Ω. Current I = V/R = 12/2.4 = 5 A.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: What is the hybridization of the central atom in SF₆?
questions.explanation: SF₆ has octahedral geometry with 6 bonding pairs. The hybridization is sp³d² (or d²sp³).

questions.question: Which of the following compounds will show optical isomerism?
questions.explanation: Lactic acid (CH₃CH(OH)COOH) has a chiral carbon atom with four different groups attached, showing optical isomerism.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which of the following oxides is amphoteric in nature?
questions.explanation: Al₂O₃ (aluminium oxide) is amphoteric - it reacts with both acids and bases.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If sin θ + cos θ = √2, then what is the value of tan θ + cot θ?
questions.explanation: sin θ + cos θ = √2 implies θ = 45°. tan 45° + cot 45° = 1 + 1 = 2.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which enzyme is responsible for unwinding the DNA double helix during replication?
questions.explanation: Helicase unwinds the DNA double helix by breaking hydrogen bonds between base pairs.
questions.imagePrompt: Clean biology diagram on white. Shows DNA replication fork. Double helix structure with complementary base pairs (A-T, G-C) visible. questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: In C₄ plants, the first stable product of CO₂ fixation is:
questions.explanation: In C₄ plants, CO₂ is first fixed by PEP carboxylase to form oxaloacetic acid (OAA), a 4-carbon compound.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: During spermatogenesis, meiosis I results in the formation of:
questions.explanation: Meiosis I divides one primary spermatocyte into two secondary spermatocytes. Meiosis II then produces four spermatids.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which hormone stimulates the release of bile from the gallbladder?
questions.explanation: Cholecystokinin (CCK) is secreted by the duodenum and stimulates the gallbladder to release bile into the small intestine.
